headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson Suffers Ankle Injury
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson exited Sunday’s win over the Titans just before halftime with an ankle injury, raising uncertainty about his availability for next Monday’s matchup with the Falcons. Jackson was one of several Ravens to go down in the victory. Cornerback Marlon Humphrey (calf), tight end Durham Smythe (Achilles), and right guard Andrew Vorhees […]

headline: NFL looking into exchange between Vikings' Wilson, ref Hill
summary: The NFL is looking into an unusual exchange between referee Adrian Hill and Vikings linebacker Eric Wilson that took place in Minnesota's 15-10 victory over the Dolphins, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Sunday night.

headline: NFL looking into official apparently cursing at Cardinals' McBride
summary: The NFL says it is reviewing an official's apparent use of profanity directed at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride in Sunday's game against the Giants.

headline: Kyle Juszczyk (knee), two more 49ers injured in win over Broncos
summary: For the fourth straight week, the 49ers clawed out a victory but were unable to come out of the game against the Broncos without injury concerns.

headline: Jim Harbaugh: Mike McDaniel's job "is not in jeopardy"
summary: After the Chargers lost their third game of the season in three weeks, coach Jim Harbaugh gave offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel a vote of confidence.

headline: Bears Could Pursue Trade Additions
summary: The Bears beat the Jets on Sunday, winning their second straight game without Caleb Williams at quarterback. That puts Chicago at 3-1 on the year. Having found success with Case Keenum and then Tyson Bagent under center, the Bears have managed to put themselves in strong early contention for a playoff spot.
